title: Project im working...
author: IllustriousDevice221
selftext:
So this started as a personal thing, I just wanted something for my own use.

TradingView is great but let's be real, it's not cheap. If you want multiple charts, a bunch of indicators and realtime CFD prices you're paying around $700 a year. That's crazy for an average trader.

I'm a dev so I thought screw it, I'll just build it myself. It ended up looking and working almost the same as TradingView, so I figured I'd share it.

It's open source, use it, fork it, break it, do whatever you want with it. Only thing I ask is if you get some free time, tell me what you think or what it does for you.

try when it free

[https://github.com/DimanthaBalasuriya/MuseCharts.git](https://github.com/DimanthaBalasuriya/MuseCharts.git)

comments.author: AcanthocephalaNo6605
comments.body:
TV will survive because there are lot of edge cases where vibe coded or fairly coded charts doesnt work. Eg: in tick by tick or custom range it will break. If you are showing crypto or any other markets its timing will affect chart and its canvas which will lead to drawing tool not working!

But kudos, if this is working for you product is worth pursuing.

replies.author: IllustriousDevice221
replies.body: yeah, defineatly, this is pet project i developed in my spare, the issue i address, im trading on propfirms, their pricess arnt align with most brokers, so sometimes its mesy trading on lower times frames, so with this i can directly analyse exact chart, pp gave with MT5.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: nice, the charting is the half most people never finish. the seven hundred a year mostly isn't the charts though, it's the realtime data licences, and that's the wall you hit the moment someone other than you wants to use it. where are the CFD prices coming from?

replies.author: IllustriousDevice221
replies.body: i connect MT5 through bridge, then i can get all the price data, for all the pairs that broker gives

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: the MT5 bridge is fine while it's only you. the moment a second user logs in, most brokers' terms say that feed is for the account holder only, and that's where the seven hundred a year comes back. worth reading the data clause of whichever broker before you put a price on it.

replies.author: IllustriousDevice221
replies.body: Yes point is true, i get built this for my personal use as hobby dev, but still use tv for analysis.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: as a hobby thing the bridge is the right call then. TV for reading, your own thing for execution is where most people who build this end up anyway, the charts are never worth rebuilding.

replies.author: IllustriousDevice221
replies.body: it have two side, MT5 also received lots of data we can use for do some analysis, i implement TPO chart, volume profiles into this, in tradingview to access those we have to buy premium, but with simple adjustment we still use  those profiles for free with this. even footprints can implemented, with simpel MT5 brigde.  i think its win win.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: the profile stuff is exactly where TV charges and MT5 hands it to you, so that part I buy. footprints off a broker feed is the one I'd watch though. a CFD broker's volume is that broker's book, not the exchange, so the profile shape is real but the absolute numbers are not, and the shape moves between brokers on the same pair.

replies.author: IllustriousDevice221
replies.body: yes, those profiles and footprints, might not accurate, its true, i can only take an idea, where poc build happen, and where most single prints happen, such as. but i would like to try with real data feed in future, kind true futures broker. step by step,

replies.author: IllustriousDevice221
replies.body: but as of my understanding, this can be easily copy paste into crypto, because all excanges have free apis without big delays, when comes to that, i can implement much accurate profiles with that data, its still goind on side, hopefully trying to do it later. but still for me this is hobby project not for use in real enviroment

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: crypto is the cheap place to prove the profile code, every exchange streams real prints for free so your TPO and footprints stop being an estimate. the logic ports over unchanged, only the feed swaps. do that before the futures broker, it costs nothing and tells you if the profile math holds.

replies.author: IllustriousDevice221
replies.body: Its better, i ll check it

comments.author: SmallMagicCoin
comments.body: Good start using light charts. I know exactly what you mean, seems like tradingview is upping their pricing slowly + revoking features from their free tier which is annoying.

comments.author: TenseAbundance
comments.body: The chart looks clean but the real test is the data layer. I like that moon is upfront about combining multiple feeds because users need to know where prices come from and how stale quotes are handled. Document the source latency symbol coverage and update frequency so people can judge it properly
